\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সম্প্রতি} (sômprôti)}{সম্প্রতি (sômprôti)}]{\bn{সম্প্রতি} (sômprôti) — recently}

\label{lesson:BN-C145-somproti}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for smooth, then the Bengali for rough.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সম্প্রতি}}
\textbf{\bn{সম্প্রতি}} — \emph{sômprôti} — \textquotedblleft{}recently\textquotedblright{}. Bengali's simple past adds \textbf{-\bn{লাম}} for \textquotedblleft{}I\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{\bn{আমি} \bn{সম্প্রতি} \bn{একটা} \bn{বই} \bn{পড়লাম}} — \emph{āmi sômprôti ekṭā bôi pôṛlām} — \textquotedblleft{}I recently read a book.\textquotedblright{}
